subject: gl.run.structure: how to change the burnin and numreps?

messages.author: 423f5ba965e5c187
messages.subject: gl.run.structure: how to change the burnin and numreps?
parts:
Dear all,

I have a question about the function gl.run.structure.
The function is working fine with my dart file, but I would like to increase the burnin and numreps to 10,000 and 100,000, respectively.
To do so, I ran the following script:

sr <-  gl.run.structure(
  gl11b,
  k.range = 1:5,
  num.k.rep = 10,
  burnin = 10000,
  numreps = 100000,
  noadmix = FALSE,
  exec = "./structure.exe",
  plot.out = TRUE,
  save2tmp = TRUE)

The script is working fine, but when I look at the results in the "mainparams" file the burnin and numreps are both set to 1,000.

Does someone know how can I properly parameterize these parameters?

Many thanks in advance,
Helena

messages.author: 25b837cc0a77be4e
messages.subject: Re: [dartR] gl.run.structure: how to change the burnin and numreps?
parts:
I don’t think you can easily, it’s hard coded into the utility function that builds the structure file. You could make your own version of the utility function and just change those values if you needed it quickly. 

https://github.com/green-striped-gecko/dartR/blob/fe1fd588ef32539807b20dd722482b2fb18c9651/R/utils.structure.run.r#L98

messages.author: 592079bda2cb3220
messages.subject: Re: gl.run.structure: how to change the burnin and numreps?
parts:
Hi Helena,

Thank you for reporting this bug. I fixed it. You can use this updated function by installing the developing version of dartR by typing in the R console:

library(dartR)
gl.install.vanilla.dartR(flavour = "dev")

Cheers,
Luis
